item.title: Lye Drink & Steel
item.description:
Drink Rating Notes
The First Draft 1 / 5 An experimental cocktail that tastes as though someone poured equal parts regret and unfinished business into a glass. The flavor is discordant—sharp where it should be smooth, flat where it should be bright. I suspect the recipe was never tested before being served. The bartender admitted as much. This drink should have remained theoretical.

item.title: The Crow Bar
item.description:
Drink Rating Notes
Platox Shots 2 / 5 Gelatin-based shots flavored with lime and a disproportionate amount of tequila. The ethanol-to-flavor ratio is miscalibrated by approximately thirty percent. The garnish is a lotus flower of unknown edibility—my toxicity scan returned inconclusive. I consumed one. I am still functional. The flower I left untouched.
